The builder paths moved with their test callers. No workflow called those paths directly: release.yml invokes the updated hq-anywhere-release-assets.test.sh. The cowork pack builder stays: core/packages/hq-pack-cowork/scripts/install-cowork-plugin.sh calls it at install time.

`check-skill-edit.sh` stays with its seven test dependencies, both skill linters, metadata validator and intent-index builder. The release check requires every non-excluded core file, catching accidental loss of runtime dependencies. Bench scripts stay because shipped operator documentation invokes them.

Existing-install removal is outside this staging-only change: hq-cloud rescue-core.ts must acquire matching tooling exclusions before the broader story is complete.

`core/scripts/hq-claude-plugin-launch.sh` moved to `.github/release/hq-anywhere/hq-claude-plugin-launch.sh` (US-031 criterion 2): only the HQ Anywhere Claude plugin runs it, and `build-claude-plugin.sh` copies it into the plugin. `core/functions.yaml` marks the old path removed with its released sha256, so `remove-retired-core-hooks.sh` deletes the unchanged copy from installs. Existing-install removal of the excluded test and tooling files is `core/scripts/remove-installed-test-files.sh`, run by `/update-hq`.
